name: Outrider
short_role: Reach exposed specialists before a loose defense can settle.
question: Can the keep delay or destroy a fast unit hunter before its second-tick contact?
telegraph: A forward-leaning horn marker announces second-tick contact unless prepared stakes control the route.
failure_mode: The charge reaches an exposed specialist before a dispersed defense can commit enough damage.
report_phrase: The Outrider carried breakthrough momentum into the support line.
